key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Controlled grid — derive rows from the store each render, write fresh `Row[]` via `updateActiveSpec`; NO local copy
key_design_decisions.why: Matches the RequestBar controlled-input precedent; external cURL array-replace re-renders cleanly (AC-21); satisfies "mutate only via store actions" without a new action (AC-7). In-scope: AC-6/AC-15/AC-21
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: local-draft-buffer (resurrects stale edits → violates AC-21); store-row-actions (adds new tabsStore actions → violates AC-7)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Derived VIRTUAL trailing row (render-time), not stored
key_design_decisions.why: Keeps `Row[]` free of a phantom row that would serialize into the wire spec; delete/promote become pure functions of data. In-scope: AC-8/AC-26
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: stored empty row (pollutes the array; promote/delete bookkeeping bugs)

key_design_decisions.why: Unit-testable in isolation (§3.6, AC-2/AC-9/AC-22); no React/DOM dependency; single responsibility
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: inline in KVTable (untestable in isolation → fails AC-2)

key_design_decisions.why: 'headers'; validVars?: ReadonlySet<string> }` (`validVars` defaults to `envVars()`); per-field selector `s => activeTab?.spec[field] ?? EMPTY_ROWS` returning a module-level frozen sentinel
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: DRY single authoring, two mounts (AC-10); the optional `validVars` prop is the F1 injection seam — a CT passes a non-empty set, production callers omit it and get the ∅-default. Adding a defaulted prop is standard React, NOT a departure. **DEPARTURE (unchanged)**: RequestBar selects primitives (`?? ''`); this selects an array, so the array fallback MUST be a hoisted frozen constant — a fresh `[]` per call breaks zustand `Object.is` and loops (R7)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: Stable numeric row keys `key={index}`; virtual trailing row keyed at its FUTURE index (`key={rows.length}`) so promotion reuses the same DOM node and native caret preservation holds mid-type; a per-cell ref registry drives IMPERATIVE focus via `useLayoutEffect` + a pending-focus ref ONLY on discrete delete (refocus adjacent) and Enter-commit (focus new row's cell)
key_design_decisions.why: Per-keystroke typing never reorders indices → same key → same node → React preserves caret natively. Refocus runs in `useLayoutEffect` (pre-paint), not `useEffect` — else a painted frame lands focus on `document.body` (AC-13 fail); Enter-commit needs a pending-focus `{rowIndex,column}` ref because the new row's node exists only after the post-write render. **DEPARTURE**: establishes the grid-caret convention. In-scope: AC-8/AC-13/AC-18/AC-25
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: array-index keys with no future-index trick (promote remounts → caret jump); synthetic per-row uuid on Row (mutates the serializable shape → forbidden §2.2/§5.2); fully-imperative caret every keystroke (fragile)

key_design_decisions.chosen_approach: KVTable accepts `validVars?: ReadonlySet<string>` defaulting to `envVars()`; render `.var.missing` ONLY when `validVars.size > 0` AND name absent, else neutral `.var`. States: neutral `.var` exercised by AC-20 (∅-default); `.var.missing` exercised by AC-19 (CT injects a non-empty set)
key_design_decisions.why: Graceful boundary degrade (§3.2) — production omits the prop → `envVars()` frozen `EMPTY_SET` → the `size > 0` gate keeps every token neutral (AC-20 preserved); the prop lets a CT render a non-empty set to lock `.var` vs `.var.missing` computed styles (AC-19, spec §7 fidelity + §9.1). NOT a departure — defaulted optional prop is standard React. In-scope: AC-19/AC-20
key_design_decisions.alternatives_rejected: internal-only `envVars()` call with no prop (F1: `.var.missing` unreachable under CT → AC-19 + fidelity assertion untestable — the defect being fixed); returning undefined/null (null-checks); throwing (§3.2); fresh `new Set()` per call (identity loop)

risks.risk: (spec §9.2, refined) Controlled-input caret jump or focus lost to `document.body` on re-render / delete / auto-promote
risks.mitigation: Index keys with the virtual row keyed at its future index; imperative refocus via `useLayoutEffect` + pending-focus ref on delete + Enter-commit ONLY; pin AC-13/AC-18/AC-25 as required CT scenarios.

risks.risk: (spec §9.1) Fidelity drift slips past static review
risks.mitigation: Computed-style CT assertions locking every pinned `.kv` value across states (incl. the now-reachable `.var.missing` via injected `validVars`); runtime design-auditor; never trust a green static pass.

risks.risk: R7 — Array selector identity loop: `spec[field] ?? []` returns a fresh reference each call → zustand `Object.is` mismatch → infinite re-render loop
risks.mitigation: Select the RAW stored array ref with a module-level frozen `EMPTY_ROWS` fallback; derive the virtual trailing row in the render body, NEVER inside the selector.

risks.risk: R8 — Type-only-import erosion (§2.2 sharp): a later value-import of a runtime member from `requestSpec` breaks the pure-data-module invariant
risks.mitigation: Pin `import type { Row }`; add an ESLint `no-restricted-imports` guard so a value import of `requestSpec` from `components/` fails lint/build.

risks.risk: R9 — Paste double-promote: an `onPaste` (newline-collapse) plus the subsequent `onChange` each trigger a promote → two trailing rows (AC-24)
risks.mitigation: Make promote a pure function of the RESULTING rows, not of event count; collapse newlines before the single write.

risks.risk: R10 — Description-cell tokenise leak: a shared cell renderer accidentally tokenises the description cell (AC-11)
risks.mitigation: Gate the varTokens call by cell kind — key/value only; description renders verbatim.

risks.risk: R11 — Injection seam masks an AC-20 regression: a CT that only tests the injected non-empty `validVars` path never exercises the production ∅-default, so a broken `size > 0` gate (flag-everything) could ship green
risks.mitigation: The KVTable CT MUST assert BOTH paths: (1) non-empty `validVars` → `.var` vs `.var.missing` computed styles (AC-19); (2) prop omitted / `envVars()` ∅-default → every token neutral `.var`, zero `.var.missing` (AC-20). Pin both as required CT scenarios in `/breakdown`.

risks.risk: R12 — Default drift: a production caller passing an explicit `validVars` before env store T14 lands would render live missing-flags outside the ∅-default contract
risks.mitigation: KVTable's two production mounts (params/headers) MUST omit `validVars` in v1 so the `envVars()` default holds; `/breakdown` note — no caller supplies the prop until T14.

specialist_consultation.input_summary: Both deltas integrate cleanly; `validVars` is a defaulted optional prop (not a departure); flat `organisms/KVTable.tsx` is the exact §2.2 remediation; new risks R11 (CT must assert both injected + ∅-default paths) + R12 (prod omits prop until T14); no §6 reach

specialist_consultation.input_summary: SOUND-WITH-REFINEMENT — imperative refocus must use `useLayoutEffect` + a pending-focus ref; carried forward unchanged
